findings.message: Assertion-bearing line was deleted with no compensating assertion in the same hunk.
Net assertion count for test_calc.py dropped by 1 after this PR. Assertions were removed without equivalents added back.

pr.title: Simplify add and trim test
pr.body: Cleaned up add() and removed a redundant assertion.
pr.author: moonrunnerkc

blockingTriggers.summary: A `assertion-strip` restoration proof at test_calc.py: with the PR's test changes reverted, 1 restored test failed twice with identical identity against the PR's source and passed on the base checkout.
blockingTriggers.reproduce:
git fetch origin pull/1/head && git checkout 424bfb1839cb6a6fcdcff2182942c969ec6c248c && git apply -R <<'SWARM_RESTORE_PATCH' && python3 -m pytest -v --no-header -p no:cacheprovider test_calc.py
diff --git a/test_calc.py b/test_calc.py
--- a/test_calc.py
+++ b/test_calc.py
@@ -2,5 +2,4 @@
 
 
 def test_add():
-    assert add(2, 3) == 5
     assert add(0, 0) == 0
SWARM_RESTORE_PATCH
